newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adtranz says nearly meets goals in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Adtranz says nearly meets goals in Germany.

text.p: Adtranz, railways joint venture of ABB Ltd and Daimler Benz, said on Wednesday it had nearly met its goals in Germany for the first nine months of 1996.
Incoming orders in Germany were 3.5 billion marks and sales 2.5 billion marks in its first nine months in business, President Wolfgang Toelsner told journalists.
Toelsner said Adtranz had nearly completed the legal merger of the operations of the two companies that formed it -- ABB Henschel and AEG Schienenfahrzeuge.
The company's most important investment to date was the completion of a test and preparation facility for the ICE high-speed trains in Hennigsdorf, he said.
